description: Na₂Ni₃P₂(HO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one H and seven O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.68 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.13 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-54°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Ni and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four equivalent Na and one P atom.
